messages:
Alex M: Heads-up — planning a smart-routing cutover tomorrow 13:00 PT. Scope: smart-router service config + canary toggle. No schema changes. Looking for smoke owner, rollback plan, and quick checklist before I schedule the deploy window.
Sara T: I can own smoke for the first 30m. Will watch latency, error-rate, and traffic split. :thumbsup:
Jamal K: Confirmed we have a 13:00 PT window. Canary plan: 10% for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then full. Ops will stand by for rollback.
deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved by @Alex M for 2024-06-12 13:00 PT — channel #eng-releases. Reminder will post 30m before start.
Ops Pager: Quick Q — is rollback automated via the canary controller or manual? Also who runs db-migrations (if any)?
Alex M: No DB migrations. Canary controller will handle traffic splits. Rollback plan: manual toggle back to previous config + optional rollback deployment if we see regressions. Lia will share commands.
Lia P: Rollback commands (manual):
```
# revert deployment to last stable revision
kubectl rollout undo deployment/smart-router -n prod
# fallback traffic config
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://admin.internal/api/config -d '{"smart_routing_enabled":false}'
```
I'll be online during the whole window and can run these within 3 minutes if needed.
Alex M: Observability watchlist (owners):
- Sara: 95th latency > 1200ms
- Jamal: error-rate spike > 1.5x baseline
- Maria: 5xxs > 0.5% of requests
Also watch KV cache hit ratio and queue length. If any threshold hits, stop rollout and fallback.
Maria S: Noted. I’ll set a short dashboard with alerts and add an on-call pager rule for the window.
Jamal K: I'll leave the canary automation set to 10% for first 15m then manual advance. If metrics good, I will advance to 50%.
Sara T: smoke checklist (short):
- sanity ping /health => 200
- smoke sample requests for top-5 routes => compare responses
- latency & error checks on dashboards
- logs quick-scan for new stack traces
I’ll post quick results in this thread.
Ops Pager: A couple ops items — ensure runbook link in the channel and assign rollback owner. Also tag infra for network checks.
Alex M: Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/smart-routing-cutover
Rollback owner: Lia P
Infra check: @Jamal K please ping infra on the day; they’re on standby.
Lia P: I’ve annotated the runbook with exact commands and verified RBAC for the rollback token. Token stored in Vault path: secret/prod/smart-router/admin (ops only).
Maria S: Dashboards created and alerting TTL set to 1m for critical metrics. Pager rule added for the window.
Jamal K: infra pinged, they ACK. They’ll watch for connection drops and confirm NLB health during canary.
Alex M: Final ask — sign-offs needed by EOD today. Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.
Sara T: :thumbsup:
Lia P: :thumbsup:
Maria S: :thumbsup:
Jamal K: :thumbsup:
Alex M: Thanks team — I’ll schedule the final deploy and post the 30m reminder. If anyone needs to change owners, update this thread.
